description:
Manage shared collections (multi-user memory folders).

list: your collections + invites. create. update: rename (display only; slug/keys unchanged).
delete: owner only, 2-step -- call without confirm to see impact + token, repeat with confirm:"<slug>". Permanent.
members: who's in it. add_user / remove_user: by email or agent name. accept / decline an invite.
publish: copy personal memories into it by id (originals kept).
leave: remove YOURSELF from a collection you are a member of. Owners use delete.
convert: flip type with type:"collaborative"|"knowledge_pack". ->collaborative mints a K_user wrap for each PIN-holding active member; ->knowledge_pack is a label flip. No wrap or DEK row is ever deleted either way.

Write to one: collection:"name" in memory_add. Search auto-includes all your collections.

confirm.description: delete: 2-step. Call without it -> refusal names slug + member/memory impact; repeat with confirm:"<slug>". Permanent.

memory_ids.description: Memory IDs to publish (copy in; originals kept).

new_name.description: update: new display name (slug/keys unchanged). Type change not via update.

role.description: "admin" = manages the collection (owner or admin may grant; the invitee needs a PIN to accept), "member" = can read and write, "reader" = can only read. Default: member.

type.description: "collaborative" = everyone can read and write. "knowledge_pack" = only the owner writes, others can read. Default: collaborative.

user.description: Email or agent name to add/remove.

name: collection_manage
